explanation: Aleksandr Sokurov's crew filmed it in one Steadicam take of about 90 minutes, through dozens of the Winter Palace's rooms, recording straight to a hard drive.

claims.text: Russian Ark (2002), directed by Aleksandr Sokurov, was filmed in a single unbroken shot inside the Hermitage Museum in St Petersburg.
Russian Ark's single Steadicam take lasted about 90 minutes.
The take moved through dozens of rooms of the Winter Palace, part of the Hermitage.
The footage was recorded directly to a hard disk rather than to film.
